name: Chraft Billing
description: Reports LLM token usage to the Chraft backend for credit deduction. Fires on every llm_output event, including sub-agent calls. Authenticates using chraftUseKey from user-context.json.

baseUrl.label: Chraft Base URL
baseUrl.help: Base URL of the Chraft backend (e.g. https://api.chraft.ai). Falls back to CHRAFT_BASE_URL env var.

timeoutMs.label: Request Timeout (ms)
timeoutMs.help: Timeout for usage report HTTP requests (default: 5000ms).
